blocks.text: CARACAS — Former political prisoners of Venezuela’s Rodeo I are unable to shake the memories of punishments dealt out by hooded jailers in the country’s most notorious prison. The maximum security facility, one of four towers that make up El Rodeo prison on the outskirts of Caracas, is reserved exclusively for opponents of the government. Several former inmates want to shed light on what goes on inside those walls, despite fears of reprisal from the authorities who put them there in the first place.
